description: Schema v1 of the quota_readings stream.

bracket.description: S700 id shared by the readings of one admission (before and after its turn)

caller.description: S700 module that asked for the reading (pilot_core, implementer_transport, profile_failover, ...)

derived.description: computed from other records; replaced on recomputation

entity.description: key of a mutable entity: keep the latest version (by ts, then record_id)

error_class.description: typed class of an error (code, exception name or TEXT_<digest>)

limit_category.description: S700 quota category as the usage command prints it, as a slug

limit_label.description: S700 limit kind as the usage command prints it, as a slug

limit_reset_at.description: S700 reset time of the limit window (UTC)

limit_window.description: S700 window of the limit read from its kind (weekly, five_hour, daily, <n>_hour)

previous_remaining_percent.description: S700 the value before this change (unit: percent)

previous_reset_at.description: S700 the reset before this change, when it differs

previous_seen_ts.description: S700 time of the last reading that still showed the previous value

profile.description: CLI credential profile alias of the lane (A, A2, B, C)

query_s.description: S700 duration of the usage command of the reading (unit: s)

reader.description: S700 reading of an admission (admission:before, admission:after: around one turn under the profile lock) or of a held preparation (retry_hold)

reading_id.description: S700 id of one reading (its limit rows share it)

reading_source.description: S700 record the reading came from: LEDGER (receipts/quota), BUDGET_STATE (state/agy-budget-<profile>.json), SNAPSHOT_BACKFILL (a QUOTA snapshot of that file), FAILOVER_EVENT (a profile failover decision)

record_id.description: stable id: sha256 of the source pointer and the normalized content, or of an explicit identity for observations, snapshots and derived rows

remaining_percent.description: S700 remaining share of the limit window as printed (whole points) (unit: percent)

ts.description: UTC time of the fact; the partition day

ts_basis.description: set when ts is not the record time itself

unchanged_readings.description: S700 readings of the same value the ledger left out since its previous row of this limit

units.description: unit of every field of the record that has one

title: quota_readings
